6.1 Sources of Clinical Data The efficacy of upadacitinib in rheumatoid arthritis was
evaluated in five Phase 3 studies. Study M13-545 (SELECT-COMPARE) compared upadacitinib
15 mg once daily with placebo and with adalimumab 40 mg every other week in subjects on
background methotrexate. Study M14-465 (SELECT-NEXT) enrolled 661 subjects with an
inadequate response to conventional synthetic DMARDs. Study M13-549 was a monotherapy
trial. Supporting dose-ranging data came from Study M13-537 (BALANCE-I) and Study
M13-550 (BALANCE-II), both Phase 2b.
<<<PAGE 13>>>
Pharmacokinetic characterization was based on protocol M13-838 in healthy volunteers.
The applicant submitted results registered as NCT02629159 and NCT02675426. See Table 5-1
for a summary of exposure, and refer to Section 14-2 of the label. Doses of 7.5-mg and
30-mg were studied. Guidance ICH-E9 was followed. The review period covered 2018.11
through 2019.08.
